race.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (Div 1)
race.verdict: GOLDWORK found some improvement with all equipment removed in what appeared a good race for the level on his first tapeta start here recently and is fancied to follow up from an 8 lb higher mark. Lady Mariko and Tasdeed head the opposition. GOLDWORK LADY MARIKO TASDEED (FR)
